# Status pane corpus

Every fix to pane-text status detection adds the pane captured in the report here, so the same shape can never regress silently. Save the ANSI-stripped capture (from the issue, or `tmux capture-pane -p -t <pane>`) as `<tool>/issue<N>-<short-shape>.txt`, replace anything personal (names, paths, hosts, prompts) with neutral text while keeping every glyph, rule and footer row the detector reads, and add one entry to `corpus.json` with `file`, `tool`, `expected` (`active`, `waiting` or `error`, the verdict `ClassifyPaneFrame` must reach for that frame alone) and `source` (the issue number, `#N`); when the bug was in the substate rather than the frame verdict (Claude: `running`, `idle-at-empty-prompt`, `interactive-menu`, `background-work`, ...) also set `substate`. `TestStatusPaneCorpus` then checks the tool's own detector against `expected` and checks that no other tool's detector reads an idle frame as running; `TestStatusPaneCorpusManifest` fails if a file has no entry or an entry has no file. The older flat `../status_corpus` (labels in `labels.tsv`) is the 2026-09-23 audit snapshot; its frames are also run through the cross-tool check.
